about: Applied by install-windows.ps1 to Herdr's own `spaces` mod after `mod.clone spaces my-spaces`: adds the OpenRig 'rig' badge, the 'Add an OpenRig team' button, a folder picker on the Spaces + button, and a folder picker on each machine row's + too: on a WSL machine the picked Windows folder becomes its WSL path (\wsl.localhost<distro>... or C:... as /mnt/c/...); other machines start in their home. Each find must occur exactly once.

edits.find: import { spaces, machines, panes, run, openOverlay, exec, hc, theme, shared, setShared, watchFolder, window, layout } from "herdr";

edits.replace:
.child(div().flex_initial().min_w(SIDE_MIN).truncate().text_color(t.foreground).child(w.name))
          // An OpenRig team's space wears a "rig" badge (with the rig's name when the space is named otherwise).
          .when(Boolean(this.rigs?.[w.id]), el => el.child(div().flex_none().px(5).py(1).rounded(4).bg("#7465db33").text_color("#a59bef").text_size(9.5)
            .child(this.rigs[w.id] === w.name ? "rig" : `rig · ${this.rigs[w.id]}`)))

this.rigs = rigSpaces();
    const list = this.grouped(t, collapsed);

.child(h_flex().gap(2).items_center()
          // Add an OpenRig team as a space (the board's "OpenRig teams" popup).
          .child(div().id("space-add-rig").size(26).flex_none().flex().items_center().justify_center().rounded(6).hover(s => s.bg(t.hover).text_color(t.foreground))
            .tooltip("Add an OpenRig team")
            .on_click(() => openOverlay({ mod: "herdr-board", kind: "popup", width: 420, props: { role: "rigs" } }))
            .child(svg("mods/workspace-chrome/layers.svg").size(14)))
          .child(div().id("space-new").size(26).flex_none().flex().items_center().justify_center().rounded(6).hover(s => s.bg(t.hover).text_color(t.foreground))
            .tooltip("New space in a folder…")
            // Ask where the new space starts (this computer's folder picker); cancel makes nothing.
            .on_click(() => { pickFolder({ prompt: "New space in…" }).then(folder => { if (folder) run("space.new", { folder, machine: "" }); }).catch(() => {}); })
            .child(svg("mods/workspace-chrome/plus.svg").size(14)))))
